purpose: Recover durable value from PROMETEO LAB R1-A research/checkpoint/experiment/artifact/decision work without replaying the lab, fabricating missing CP semantics, or allowing historical visual/product research to override Current/Lineage/current owners.

source_quality.rule: Current/Lineage/owner contracts decide present authority. Historical chat can preserve run status, required artifact names and rationale, but cannot prove missing source contents, implementation provenance, Human Acceptance, Current or Served state.

privacy.rule: Only sanitized technical/product recovery metadata is public.

runtime_reconciliation.reason_for_general: No dedicated R1-A owner existed when R01 started.
runtime_reconciliation.owner_action: Created the smallest recovery-only owner r1a-experience-recovery and scoped branch recovery/r1a-r01-20260909 before material recovery writes.
runtime_reconciliation.currentness_rule: No Current/Human Accepted/Served pointer was changed or inferred from R1-A.

historical_execution_recovery.scope: Historical/visual/product-experience archaeology, decisions, capability/version comparison, design laws/kernel, responsive/accessibility analysis, product-specific experience synthesis, visual alternatives, red-team/repair and implementation-ready specification work.

checkpoint_protocol.blocked_reason: Canonical 50-Gate checkpoint semantics/source were unavailable, so checkpoint identifiers could be touched but not truthfully resolved against their authoritative definitions.
checkpoint_protocol.rule: Do not synthesize CP-001..CP-500 definitions, outcomes, owners or PASS states from memory, later artifacts or numbered filler.

formal_handoff.reason: The canonical 50-Gate source required for semantic completion was unavailable.
formal_handoff.recovery_action: Do not mint a retroactive completed R1A_HANDOFF. This recovery record is a new recovery artifact, not the missing historical handoff.

later_program_decision.historical_context: A later program decision selected the more advanced R1-C path as the master lab route and froze R1-A/R1-B as optional evidence rather than dependencies.
later_program_decision.recovery_effect: R1-A must not be reintroduced as a prerequisite or master authority.

artifact_registry_state.meaning: The historical required deliverable identity is recoverable, but its original body/bytes/hash/manifest are not.
not_allowed: Recreate a missing artifact and label it original R1-A output.
Use a later similarly named/current subsystem as the artifact body.
Infer a visual winner or implementation spec from the deliverable name alone.

recovered_durable_findings.finding: R1-A's durable value is best preserved as provenance-aware research evidence, not as a product/runtime authority.
Historical version/capability comparison must distinguish exact artifact identity, scoped capability and currentness instead of ranking by version number or visual recency.
Visual/interaction quality must preserve product identity and accepted interaction physics rather than homogenizing every product through one design rewrite.
Design-system research such as kernel, color, material, typography, motion and controls is evidence/design input until tied to exact implementation and scoped acceptance.
A numbered checkpoint ledger is not evidence of successful verification when the canonical checkpoint semantics are unavailable.
A/B visual alternatives, red-team findings and repaired proposals require their exact bodies/evidence to recover a winner; their filenames alone cannot carry the decision.

negative_knowledge.rule: BLOCKED checkpoint is not a failed product test; it is an evidence/definition boundary.
Unavailable historical bytes do not prove historical work never existed; record UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN rather than ABSENT.
Later convergence does not prove R1-A provenance, ownership or causal adoption.
A required artifact name is not a substitute for the artifact body, manifest or decision evidence.
Chat-reported ADD-01..18 PASS does not resolve CP-001..500 or authorize a completed R1A handoff.
Do not rebuild current products from historical visual research when exact accepted product owners already exist.
Do not promote draft Design Kernel/visual laws into a global design authority without exact source, owner contract and scoped acceptance.
R1-A being broad or exhaustive does not make it a dependency; later explicit program routing froze it as optional evidence.

chat_only_or_exact_source_gaps: Original canonical 50-Gate protocol source and exact CP-001..CP-500 semantics.
Original R1-A package filename, manifest, file count, bytes and cryptographic hashes.
Exact bodies of all required R1-A named artifacts.
Exact per-checkpoint evidence, owner, result and rationale for CP-001..CP-500.
Exact ADD-01..ADD-18 definitions and evidence despite historical PASS report.
Exact Visual Direction A and B content, comparison dimensions and selected/hybrid winner.
Exact known visual/interaction disease entries and red-team attacks/results.
Exact repaired experience proposal and implementation-ready visual specification.
Exact product-specific Classes/Student World/PageKit R1-A synthesis bodies.
Any explicit durable lineage edge proving that a later current capability was adopted specifically from R1-A.

continuation_rule.if_authentic_source_appears: Record exact repository/file/hash provenance, compare only affected registry/matrix entries, upgrade states item-by-item, and preserve Current/Lineage authority ceilings.
continuation_rule.if_new_product_work_is_requested: Route to the current owner; do not restart R1-A.
